Power zones at — W

Standard seven-zone model (Coggan), the same one Strava uses. Sweet Spot isn’t a zone of its own — it’s the 88–94% band across the top of Tempo and the bottom of Threshold, so a sweet-spot ride shows on Strava as Z3/Z4 time. That’s expected.

Heart rate zones at — bpm max
Form zones

Form is Fitness minus Fatigue — the gap between the two lines. Where it sits tells you what to do next.

+25 & upToo fresh — tapered, fitness fading
+5 to +25Fresh — race-ready
−10 to +5Neutral — maintaining
−10 to −30Productive — build here
below −30Overreaching — back off soon

Quick guide

Before a ride

  1. Wake the trainer and strap, then click the bike and heart tiles and pick them from the list. Click a connected tile to disconnect.
  2. Log in to Strava once and rides can be uploaded straight from the summary.
  3. Set your FTP and max HR in the Rider box at the bottom (type, or nudge with ▲▼) — every target scales from FTP.
  4. Filter by time, zone, spice or shape; ★ marks favourites.
  5. Start Workout, then pedal — the clock starts after a 3-2-1.

During

  • Stop pedalling and it pauses itself; pedal to resume, or Resume now.
  • Skip jumps to the next segment. End finishes early.
  • Beeps count 3-2-1 into each segment. Blocks are the plan; yellow is your power, red heart rate, purple cadence.

After

  • Sync to Strava sends the ride with laps matching the intervals; Download .fit if you'd rather upload by hand.
  • Download Timeline Image gives a 4:3 summary to attach as a photo.
  • Two pies show time in power zones (focus zone pushed out) and heart-rate zones — the HR one needs your max HR in the Rider box.
  • Ramp and 20-min tests offer an FTP estimate with a Set button.

Keys

← →collapse / open this panel
↑ ↓move through the list
Enterstart the selected workout
Spacepause · resume now
↑ ↓intensity ±1% while riding
Escclose the summary or this guide

Good to know

  • Use Chrome or Edge — Bluetooth pairing isn't available in Firefox or Safari.
  • Skip the picker next time: enable chrome://flags/#enable-web-bluetooth-new-permissions-backend, relaunch, connect once — from then on the app finds your trainer and strap by itself when you open it (the tiles show Looking…).
  • Chilli rating is heat within a focus area, not across them: a 🌶🌶🌶🌶🌶 sweet spot ride is still easier than a 🌶 threshold ride.
  • Sweet Spot is a training focus, not a Strava zone — those rides show as Tempo/Threshold (Z3/Z4) time on Strava. See the ? next to FTP.
  • Est. avg power and Normalised on a workout are what the plan asks for at your FTP, not a prediction of your ride.
  • Nothing leaves this browser except what you send to Strava: settings live in the browser, exports in Downloads.
